R1.reason: Three steps send the builder to "the plans" (the Extras download) for layout the plan itself never gives: where the parts of the headboard/footboard go, the drawer-opening size that fixes the face-frame stile positions, and the groove layout for the false fronts. Search of all steps, cutList and materials for an opening size or stile spacing found none. Part sizes are in the cut list, so likely rather than certain that the structure cannot be completed.

R2.reason: Every part a step makes (posts, rails, panels, face frame rails/stiles, false-front rails/stiles/panels, drawer fronts/sides/bottoms, slide supports, 1x4 slats) maps to a cut-list row; "Bed Slats" (11 x 3/4x3 1/2x38) correspond to "Secure 1x4s to supports".

R3.reason: Search of all steps, title, description and summary for /mount/ found no match; step 10 attaches the false fronts by drilling through the drawer pull holes into the drawer box and no step uses a separate mounting piece. Row is qty 3 [0.75, 4, 10].

R4.reason: Hardwood parts (posts, caps, rails, stiles) come from materials[4] "Hardwood ,, Board feet" with no thickness or width stated, so stock cannot be compared with §9. Sheet parts all fit: 3/4 ply (drawer fronts/sides, braces), 1/4 ply (bottoms), 1/2 MDF panels, laminated 1/4 beadboard + 1/4 ply = 0.5 for the 35.75 x 40.25 headboard panel; none exceeds 48 x 96.

R5.reason: R5 precondition not met: unparseable stock materials[4]

evidence.quote: Position the "keyed" plates and use 3/4” screws to attach it.

R6.reason: 3/4" screws are used for the keyhole plates; search of materials[].name for /3\/4/ finds only plywood lines, so no 3/4" fastener is listed. "Drywall Screws" (materials[8]) has no size, and steps[10] gives only "no more than 3"" spacing.

R8.reason: Order works: frame parts milled and dadoed (steps[1]), panel laminated (steps[2]) before headboard/footboard assembly (steps[3]); face frames (steps[4,5]) and false fronts (steps[6,7]) and drawers (steps[8]) before final assembly (steps[10]).

Search of steps and cut list for these found only the references to "the plans". Images viewed (steps 3,5,6,10 and 4 unattached) are workshop/room photos with no dimensions.

R14.reason: (a) 3 drawers = 6 "Drawer Front" (fronts+backs) + 6 sides + 3 bottoms; 6 false fronts = 6 panels + 12 rails + 12 stiles; 2 face frames = 4 rails + 8 stiles as steps[5] ("outside stiles", "center stiles"). (b) built parts are installed in steps[10] (the unused Mounting Piece is recorded under R3). (c) keyhole hardware, slides and pulls are in materials. (d) steps reach the assembled bed.

gaps.what: Hardwood bought as 10 board feet; summed volume of the hardwood parts is 3758.5 cu in (posts 2x3x3x50.5 + 2x3x3x24.5, caps 2x1.5x3.5x44, top/bottom rails 4x1.5x3.5x35, center rails 2x1.25x3.5x35, bed frame rails 4x0.75x2x75, stiles 8x0.75x2x7.5, drawer-front rails 12x0.75x1.5x22.0625, stiles 12x0.75x1.5x5), about 26 board feet if a board foot is 144 cu in (a definition not in section 9).
